entries.rationale: Spec carries the template body verbatim plus AC-1..AC-5/AC-8/AC-9 and the plan authors the full test; two new files, no boundary rules (boundaries.yaml empty). In-repo precedent tests/constitution.test.mjs matches the read-a-file-and-assert-text shape, but no curated golden sample covers static-artifact tests.

One flag on two existing prose lines, but the spec describes the edit two ways (lines 84 vs 91) and the plan had to pin --body-file; task also amends the spec and bumps its revision. Of 7 non-test files, 4 are regenerated by scripts/sync-provider-skills.mjs, not hand-edited, so blast radius is 2 canonical SKILL.md files across 2 modules, not 6.

Single-file test append with the assertion semantics pinned by CON-1 (start-of-line '## ' + heading), but the how is undefined: prBodyOutputPaths() is a placeholder awaiting pr-body-composition.spec.md, so the fixture surface must be designed, with an explicit do-not-stub rule. No precedent for enumerating output paths of an unshipped verb.
